svg.title: Seoul Jongno simulated signal queue change
svg.desc: OpenStreetMap roads with eight signal markers. Green markers show lower mean queues; red markers show higher mean queues after adaptive control.

svg.text: Legend: green = lower queue ? red = higher queue ? amber = similar queue
Marker radius and glow show absolute queue-change magnitude. Map shows mapped signal points only.
Map: ? OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Overlay: SUMO simulation, 2026-11-01 08:00, fixed-time vs PPO adaptive plan.
